title: Scale Arena
lede: Ten bouts a day, from protons to superclusters. Don't just pick the bigger fighter: bet how many times bigger it is, on a log scale. Lock in, and the camera zooms out through the powers of ten to show both at true scale. Good bets build a streak multiplier; rounds 5 and 10 are boss bouts.
description: Scale Arena: bet on size ratios from protons to the observable universe, then watch a powers-of-ten zoom reveal the truth.
